name: Krishiv product additions
extends: tokens-src/brand-tokens.json (version 2): every brand colour, type family, space and radius is taken from there unchanged
note: Only what a data-heavy console needs and the brand system does not have. scripts/build-tokens.mjs merges both files into src/tokens/product.css. Contrast of every text pair is checked by axe on the pages that use it.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Grid and list row under the pointer.

tokens.name: sel-bg
tokens.usage: Selected row, current tree node, active editor tab ground. A gold tint, not a gold fill.

tokens.name: sel-edge
tokens.usage: The 2px left edge of a selected row (pairs with sel-bg).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, drawers and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only (menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs). Cards keep borders, no shadow.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Plan heatmap: empty track.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Plan heatmap: under 10% of the time.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Plan heatmap: 10 to 30%.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Plan heatmap: 30 to 50%.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Plan heatmap: over half the time. Gold means where the time went; nothing else in a profile is gold.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (gold): the series the reader should look at first.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (silver).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (steel blue).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (violet).

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (teal).

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (rose). Status colours (ok, warn, err) are never series colours.

tokens.name: null
tokens.usage: The word null in a result cell, italic. At least 4.5:1 on surface, row-hover and sel-bg in both themes.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page. Product pages never use the brushed metal or the 40px+ display sizes.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Controls, menus, grid cells (the engine console already uses 14px).

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Help text and descriptions inside the console.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers, ids, SQL, paths; tabular figures so columns line up.

tokens.name: ctl-h
tokens.usage: Control height with a fine pointer (desktop). WCAG 2.2 target size minimum is 24px.

tokens.name: ctl-h-touch
tokens.usage: Control height with a coarse pointer and below 768px (the brand's 44px touch rule).

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Grid row, comfortable density (default).

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Grid row, compact density (a per-person setting).

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: The frame's top bar.

tokens.name: nav-w
tokens.usage: Side menu, 1280px and wider.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Side menu as an icon rail, 768 to 1279px.

tokens.name: dur-1
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle: inside Nielsen's 0.1 s 'instant' limit.

tokens.name: dur-2
tokens.usage: Menus, drawers, toasts entering.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Every transition. prefers-reduced-motion sets durations to 0.

tokens.name: phone
tokens.usage: Checked at 390. One column; menu in a drawer; grids become cards or scroll inside their own frame.

tokens.name: tablet
tokens.usage: Checked at 768. Icon rail; side panels become sheets.

tokens.name: laptop
tokens.usage: Checked at 1024. Icon rail; two panes.

tokens.name: desktop
tokens.usage: Checked at 1440. Full menu; three panes in the SQL editor.
